newsitem.title: UK: Further details on UK Q2 GDP revisions.
newsitem.headline: Further details on UK Q2 GDP revisions.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics said the upward revision to second quarter GDP in the UK to 0.5 percent growth from 0.4 percent reflected a broad based increase in output across several sectors.
-- Construction was revised to up 0.1 percent quarter-on- quarter from a fall of 0.3 percent previously.
-- distribution, hotels and catering up to 1.1 percent from an initial 0.9 percent
-- transport, storage and communications revised up to 0.8 percent from 0.7 percent
-- financial, business services up to 1.5 percent from 1.1.
But total production growth on the quarter was revised down to 0.1 percent growth from an initial 0.2 percent.
